name: Novice Flickercraft
desc: You have practiced your flickercraft, and can typically get a usable vision from a campfire.

abilities.name: Flickercraft
Flame Reading
abilities.effect: As a _Camp Action_ when you have a campfire you may attempt to peer into what is to come on your next day of travel. Roll a die; on a 4+, the GM places a random _Discovery_, _Menace_, or _Event_ (your choice) in the deck face-up, which treats the card as already revealed when drawn. Along with this, you get a hazy vision of what is to come, the full details of which make sense when confronted with the situation. If you fail the roll, your spirit may gain _Stress_ to instead succeed.

abilities.name: Burning Augury
abilities.effect: You can look into a flame and attempt to chart potential futures, guiding your course of action. You and your spirit may both gain _Stress_ to ask your GM what the outcome of a specific action you take will be. Depending on how far reaching the consequences will be, you may need a campfire (for something as immediate as 'what would happen if I pull this lever') up to a razing inferno, for something that may take a season or more to occur ('what will happen if we plant crops in this field'). If you do not have a sufficient flame for an adequate answer, do not gain _Stress_.

abilities.name: Flickering Futures
abilities.effect: If you are in an _Arena_ with any _Flamesource_ at _Respite_, choose one enemy; the GM will tell you what _Stance_ they are choosing and the specifics of how it works.

imbues.name: Visions of Flames Past
imbues.effect: You may use this even if there is not a _Flamesource_ present, as you recall visions that now make sense.

name: Novice Blazecraft
desc: You have an aptitude for controlling flames and can bend them to your will with a thought.

abilities.name: Blazecraft
Everburning
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ for yourself or an ally that your ability to create and control fire could mitigate.

abilities.name: Spreading Flames
abilities.effect:
Choose one:
* _Ignite_ a piece of _Flammable_ _Terrain_ within the Target.
* Choose _Blazing_ _Terrain_ within Range and make it _Roaring_.

enhances.name: Sustaining Blaze
enhances.effect: Instead, create a _Blazing_ _Engagement_ within Range. This does not need _Flammable_ _Terrain_.

abilities.name: Ember
abilities.effect: On a _Miss_, _Ignite_ all _Terrain_ the Target is _Engaged_ with.

enhances.name: Erupting Flame
enhances.effect: Instead, Target is an _Engagement_. After resolving the Attack, _Ignite_ the _Engagement_.

enhances.name: Hungry Flame
enhances.effect: Add _Alight_ [3]. You may repeat this _Enhancement_.

name: Novice Field Medic
desc: You can quickly stabilize allies in the field, and have the instincts required to keep them standing just a little longer.

abilities.name: Field Medicine
abilities.effect: You may remove a single _Danger_ related to doing medical work under extreme danger and duress.

abilities.name: Emergency Medicine
abilities.prereqs: _Wearing_ _Physician's Tools_ with at least 1 use remaining.
abilities.effect: Immediately Move towards the ally by the most direct route possible, paying all costs as normal. If you end this _Movement_ _Engaged_ with them, spend a use of _Physician's Tools_. They may roll twice for their _Wound_ and take the better result.

abilities.name: Triage
abilities.prereqs: _Wearing_ _Physician's Tools_ with at least 1 use remaining.
abilities.effect:
Expend X uses from your _Physician's Tools_, then choose X of the following. You may choose the same option multiple times:
* The Target may immediately _Recover_, gaining a +2 _Bonus_ to the roll. They may not use this to _Recover_ from _Prone_, _Grappled_, _Restrained_, or similar effects.
* Make a _Recovery Roll_, then reduce the target's _Bleeding_ or _Poisoned_ value by the result plus 2.
* Restore 3 _Stamina_ to the Target.
* Restore 8 _Guard_ to the Target.
abilities.special: You may add [_Discount_ 2] by creating an _Opening_ as a part of this effect.

name: Novice Martial Artist
desc: You excel in unarmed combat, allowing you to fight with whatever is on hand as well as a weapon.

abilities.name: Martial Artist
abilities.effect: In close combat, you always gain a die in combat skill challenges for having the right equipment, even if you are unarmed.

abilities.name: Combo Meter
abilities.effect: Gain a Combo Die, which is tracked with d6 and starts at 0. Whenever you _Hit_ with an _Unarmed_ Attack, increment it by 1. You may decrement the die by 2 to gain [_Discount_ 1] on your next _Unarmed_ Attack.

abilities.name: Flowing Strikes
abilities.effect:
On a _Hit_+, choose one. If your Combo Die was at 3+ before this Attack you may choose an additional effect even on a _Miss_:
* This does not count against your Attack limit for the _Turn_.
* For the rest of the _Turn_ the Target may not respond to any _Opening_ you create.
* Add _Impaired_ [4].

enhances.name: Chain
enhances.effect: Use a different Attack. Add [_Follow-Up_]. Additionally add [_Discount_ 1] if it is [_Unarmed_].

name: Novice Dual Wielder
desc: You fight with a weapon in either hand, weaving an elegant web as you launch unpredictable strikes.

abilities.name: Whirling Dervish
abilities.effect: In narrative combat if you are dual-wielding weapons you may play _Scope_ for free.

abilities.name: Twinned Defense
abilities.effect: While _Wielding_ a non-Shield _Weapon_ in either _Hand_ increase your _Block_ by 1.

abilities.name: Flurry
abilities.effect: _Attack_ with both _Weapons_, paying all costs as normal. Instead of making a normal _Attack Roll_, instead roll 3d6. Choose one die to be shared by both Attacks, then assign the others to the Attacks however you desire, using the results as the _Attack Roll_ for either.

name: Novice Sniper
desc: You specialize in long-range combat, waiting for the opportune moment to make an attack before unleashing it.

abilities.name: Sniper's Shot
abilities.effect: In narrative combat if you don't have an enemy near you and have a ranged attack, you may play _Efficacy_ once for free.

abilities.name: Sniper's Perch
abilities.effect: At the start of your _Turn_ if you are not already _Immobilized_ you may choose to become _Immobilized_ for the remainder of your _Turn_. If you do, gain a +1 _Bonus_ to the next Single-Target Range 1+ Attack you make before moving in any way, including _Forced Movement_.

abilities.name: Held Shot
abilities.trigger: You would make a Single-Target Range 1+ Attack.
abilities.effect: Do not immediately make the Attack. Add [_Final_] to the Attack, and choose a Target. Gain _Concentrating_. Use this Attack as a _Reaction_ at any point after this _Phase_ before the end of the _Round_. It must be used against the selected Target. If you choose to use it as a part of an _Opening_, gain a +1 _Bonus_.

name: Novice Warrior
desc: You are the front line of every encounter, drawing the attention of enemies and creating a frontline, regardless of the situation.

abilities.name: Warrior's Shield
abilities.effect: When in narrative combat, you may spend one [ ] to take any Danger from an ally and put it on your stakes sheet. If you are rolling _Boldly_, you may do this once for free.

abilities.name: Warrior's Spirit
abilities.effect: Gain a Warrior Die, which is tracked with d6 and starts at 0. Whenever an ally within Range 1 is Attacked, increment the die. You may decrease the value of the die by 2 to gain 1 _Speed_, but must end the current _Turn_ _Engaged_ with an enemy. You may also decrement the die to pay any Costs associated with Warrior's Rush at a 1 to 1 rate.

abilities.name: Warrior's Rush
abilities.effect: You may immediately move to _Engage_ the enemy, paying all costs as normal. If you successfully _Engage_ them, inflict _Taunted_ [6].

enhances.name: Improved Rush
enhances.effect: Make a single _Melee_ Attack against the target after _Engaging_ them, paying all costs as normal.

name: Novice Commander
desc: You are adept at commanding others, finding the openings on the battlefield that others miss and allowing your allies to seize the opportunity.

abilities.name: Commander's Voice
abilities.effect: When in narrative combat, you may spend one [ ] to reroll it and give the resulting die to an ally.

abilities.name: Commander's Presence
abilities.effect: Gain a Commander Die, which is tracked with a d6 and starts at 0. Whenever you use an [_Inspiring_] ability, increment the die. You may decrement the die whenever an ally within range makes an _Attack_ or _Defense Roll_ to give them 4 _Guard_.

abilities.name: Commander's Orders
abilities.effect:
Choose one:
* The target may immediately make an Attack, adding [_Discount_ 1].
* The target may make a single move, adding [_Safe_].
* The target may immediately _Recover_ and gains 5 _Guard_.

name: Novice Blademaster
desc: You have studied the blade and have rare skill with it, making you incredibly dangerous and flexible in close combat.

abilities.name: Blademaster
abilities.effect: When in narrative combat, if you have a sword you may play _Efficacy_ once without using a die.

abilities.name: Blade Versatility
abilities.effect:
At _Respite_, choose one:
* Gain [_Discount_ 1] on the first _Blade_ _Attack_ you make this _Round_.
* Gain [_Discount_ 1] on the first _Parry_ _Reaction_ you make this _Round_ while _Wielding_ a _Blade_.

abilities.name: Cross Slash
abilities.effect: Increase the Result of the triggering Attack, resolving the Attack with the new Result. If the Attack was already a _Crit_, instead add the _Graze_ effect to the Attack as well, combining all effects.

name: Novice Frostcraft
desc: More advanced applications of frostcraft, allowing you to manipulate and form ice into specific shapes.

abilities.name: Frostcraft
Chilly Disposition
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ for yourself or an ally that your ability to create and control ice could mitigate.

abilities.name: Icebending
abilities.effect: You may _Bend_ up to 2 _Load_ of _Ice_ within _Range_ 1.

abilities.name: Thaw
abilities.effect:
Choose one:
* Remove _Frozen_ from a creature within Range; the creature then becomes _Soaked_.
* Choose _Terrain_ that is a _Minor_ _Source_ (_Ice_). Replace it with _Wet_.

abilities.name: Frozen Sheet
abilities.effect: Use a _Source_ (_Water_), then add _Icy_, _Tripping Hazard_ (_Ice_), or _Spikes_ (_Ice_) to an _Engagement_.

enhances.name: Thick Sheet
enhances.effect: Instead, create an _Icy_ _Island_ _Engagement_ within a _Water_ _Arena_.

abilities.name: Icicle Shot
abilities.effect: You may only use this if there is any _Water_ or _Ice_ nearby. Create and then _Safely_ _Throw_ a _Missile_ (_Ice_) at the Target.

enhances.name: Fractured Ice
enhances.effect: Instead, _Safely_ use a _Source_ (_Ice_) for this Attack. Deal +_0/2/2/2_ Damage if you do.

enhances.name: Icicle Barrage
enhances.effect: Use a _Source_ (_Ice_) for this Attack. Deal +_0/4/4/4_ Damage if you do and add a _Minor Source_ (_Ice_) to the Target's _Engagement_.

name: Novice Tidecraft
desc: You have honed your ability to control water, pushing it and pulling it much like the tides do.

abilities.name: Tidecraft
Water Shaping
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ for yourself or an ally that your ability to shape and control water could mitigate.

abilities.name: Friendly Current
abilities.effect: Once on your _Turn_ you may spend _Essence_ as if it was _Speed_ while _Swimming_ in _Water_.

imbues.name: Carrying Current
imbues.effect: This _Round_, while _Swimming, treat yourself as having two _Open Hands_ and you do not have _Disadvantage_ on _Defense_ Rolls.

abilities.name: Splash
abilities.effect: Use any _Source_ (_Water_), then add a _Wet_ _Engagement_ or grant an ally _Soaked_.

enhances.name: Unfriendly Splash
enhances.effect: You can instead inflict _Soaked_ [4] on an enemy.

abilities.name: Violent Stream
abilities.effect: _Safely_ use any _Source_ (_Water_) for this Attack.

enhances.name: Violent River
enhances.effect: Instead, use any _Source_ (_Water_) for this Attack and add _Soaked_ [3]. If the Target does not become _Soaked_, their _Engagement_ becomes _Wet_.

enhances.name: Wave Crash
enhances.effect: Instead, use a non-_Minor_ _Source_ (_Water_). Attack an _Engagement_, add _Soaked_, and make the _Engagement_ _Wet_.

enhances.name: Driving Stream
enhances.effect: Add _Push_ [1/3] to the Attack.

analysis_notes.notes: Guaranteeing Wet is a nice extra perk

name: Novice Mightcraft
desc: You can draw strength from the earth, allowing you to push towards the limits of what the human body can accomplish with sheer strength.

abilities.name: Mightcraft
Mighty Back
abilities.effect: You may carry 1 _Load_ without it affecting your _Encumbrance_. If you spend the majority of the day traveling on something other than earth, lose this benefit.

abilities.name: Strength of the Earth
abilities.effect: While on solid earth, your [_Martial_] Attacks deal +1 _Stun_.

imbues.name: Improved Resilience
imbues.effect: This _Round_, _Negate_ all _Forced Movement_, _Grab_, and _Poison_ at half cost.

abilities.name: Draw Vitality
abilities.effect:
Choose one:
* Gain [_Discount_ 1] on the next [_Martial_] Attack you make this _Turn_.
* Add _Push_ to your next [_Martial_] Attack made this _Turn_.
* Immediately gain 3 _Guard_ or decrement a _Poison_ _Status_ by 1.

name: Novice Breezecraft
desc: You make the air near you an extension of your own senses, providing you the ability to detect anything near you.

abilities.name: Breezecraft
On the Wind
abilities.effect: When _Menace_  or _Discovery_ is drawn, you may attempt to glean more info. Your spirit gains _Stress_, but you immediately learn additional information, such as the consequences of failure. You may spend [ ] to reveal this card.

abilities.name: Goosebumps
abilities.effect: When something surprising, unexpected, or dangerous would happen that could be felt through the air, your spirit may immediately gain _Stress_. You detected this with your breezecraft before it happened, and are able to act as if you were not surprised or otherwise caught off-guard.

abilities.name: Circle
abilities.effect: While in _Wind_ _Terrain_, gain +1 to all _Defend_ rolls.

imbues.name: Extended Senses
imbues.effect: Gain the effect even if you are not in _Wind_ _Terrain_.

imbues.name: Perfect Circle
imbues.effect: For the remainder of the _Round_, no attack originating from outside your _Arena_ may have _Advantage_ against you.

abilities.name: Brushing Breeze
abilities.effect: You extend your senses towards the Target; they must _Negate_ [4] or gain _Studied_. If they are in _Wind_ _Terrain_, they automatically fail to _Negate_.

name: Novice Stonecraft
desc: The fundamentals of stonecraft, which forgoes shaping massive amounts of earth for finer control and manipulation of specific objects.

abilities.name: Stonecraft
Stepping Stones
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ for yourself or an ally that your ability to control and shape stone could mitigate.

abilities.name: Earthbending
abilities.effect: You have _Bend_ [_Earth_] within Range 1.

abilities.name: Compact
abilities.effect:
Use any _Source_ (_Earth_), then create one of the following, placing all in an Arena:
*  _Plenty_ of _Tiny_ _Earth_ objects.
*  Two _Small_ _Earth_ objects.
* A _Medium_ _Earth_ object.
* Add _Spikes_ (_Earth_) to an _Engagement_.

If used to Attack, these objects deal _Crush_ Damage.

enhances.name: Shaped Stone
enhances.effect: Instead, created objects deal _Stab_ or _Slash_ Damage when used to _Attack_.

abilities.name: Earthen Fling
abilities.effect: _Fling_ a _Tiny_ _Earth_ _Object_.

enhances.name: Power
enhances.effect: _Fling_ a _Small_ _Earth_ _Object_. This is a _Balanced_ Attack and deals  +3 _Stun_ and +_2/2/3/3_ Damage.

enhances.name: Power+
enhances.effect: _Fling_ a _Medium_ _Earth_ _Object_.  Add [_Siege_]. This is a _Heavy_ Attack and deals +_1/1/2/2_ _Stun_ and +_1/2/4/4_ Damage. Increase the _Negate_ cost by 1.

name: Novice Landcraft
desc: A specialty of earthcraft that shapes the earth like clay, creating great constructs and causing quakes with equal measure.

abilities.name: Landcraft
Smooth Road
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ for yourself or an ally that your ability to control and shape soil could mitigate.

abilities.name: Shape Earth
abilities.effect:
Within the Target, choose one:
* Add a _Tripping Hazard_ (_Earth_).
* Make an _Engagement_ _Rough_ (_Earth_).
* Remove _Earth_ _Terrain_ from an _Engagement_.

enhances.name: Earth Vein
enhances.effect: Instead, Range is 1.

enhances.name: Earthen Wall
enhances.effect: Add a _Wall of Earth_ to an _Engagement_.

enhances.name: Earth Mover
enhances.effect: If you choose an effect that would target an _Engagement_, instead effect the entire _Arena_.

enhances.name: Wide Quake
enhances.effect: Instead, Target is an _Engagement_. After resolving the Attack, add _Rough_ (_Earth_).

name: Novice Stormcraft
desc: A more specialized focus of windcraft that, nonetheless, all practitioners of it have some basic skill with.

abilities.name: Stormcraft
Lightningrod
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ for yourself or an ally that your ability to create and control lightning could mitigate.

abilities.name: Stormbending
abilities.effect: You have _Bend_ [_Lightning_] within Range 1. Additionally, you may use _Brawl_ against all Targets made of _Lightning_. If you choose the <u>Steal</u> option, you may instead Target any creature, but must Target a _Lightning_ piece of _Equipment_.

abilities.name: Storm Shield
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ caused by lightning or any electricity-based effects for any character.

abilities.name: Jolt
abilities.effect: If the Target is _Wearing_ _Metal_, is _Water_, or is _Soaked_, add [_Piercing_].

enhances.name: Arc Lighning
enhances.effect: Make the Attack against another Target, adding [_Remote_] and originating from the first Target.

enhances.name: Bolt
enhances.effect: This Attack is instead _Balanced_. Deal +_2/4/4/5_ additional Damage, and increase the cost to _Negate_ by 1.

name: Novice Barkcraft
desc: You are more adept at barkcraft, and better able to make use of its finer points.

abilities.name: Barkcraft
Friendly Bark
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ for yourself or an ally that your ability to control and shape wood could mitigate.

abilities.name: Woodbending
abilities.effect: You have _Bend_ [_Wood_] within Range 1. Additionally, you may use _Brawl_ against all Targets made of _Wood_ or wearing _Wood_ Armor within that Range and paying all costs with _Essence_ instead of _Momentum_. If you choose the <u>Steal</u> option, you may instead Target any creature, but must Target a _Wood_ piece of _Equipment_.

abilities.name: Hardwood
abilities.effect: By channeling your craft you can temporarily enhance your wooden equipment.

imbues.name: Hardened Shield
imbues.effect: You gain +1 _Block_ while Wielding [_Wood_] Equipment or Wearing [_Wood_] Armor.

enhances.name: Wooden Spine
enhances.effect: Instead, use a _Load_ 2 (_Wood_) _Missile_. Deal +_1/1/2/2_ Damage.

enhances.name: Wooden Barrage
enhances.effect: Use X additional _Missiles_ of the same size. For each additional _Missile_, gain a +1 to the _Attack Roll_.

name: Novice Lodecraft
desc: You have some skill at controlling metal, and can accomplish basic manipulation feats.

abilities.name: Lodecraft
Metallic Path
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ for yourself or an ally that your ability to control and shape metal could mitigate.

abilities.name: Metalbending
abilities.effect: You have _Bend_ [_Metal_] within Range 1.

imbues.name: Projected Ward
imbues.effect: Gain +1 to all _Defense Rolls_ against _Metal_ this _Round_.

abilities.name: Metal Shot
abilities.effect: _Fling_ a _Tiny_ _Metal_ _Object_ at the Target.

enhances.name: Weight
enhances.effect: Instead, _Fling_ a _Small_ _Metal_ _Object_. This is a _Balanced_ Attack and deals +_0/1/3/4_ Damage.

name: Novice Anvilcraft
desc: The fundamentals of anvilcraft, a speciality of metalcraft that focuses on changing the structure of metal to strengthen, weaken, or alter the shape of it.

abilities.name: Anvilcraft
Fullmetal
abilities.effect: Whenever your [_Metal_] _Equipment_ would lose _Durability_ (even in narrative play) roll a d6; on a 6, it instead doesn't. Your _Spirit_ may gain _Fatigue_ to treat a failed roll as a success.

abilities.name: Honed Edge
abilities.effect: Your [_Metal_] Attacks gain [_Piercing_].

abilities.name: Hardened Hide
abilities.effect: Gain +1 _Block_ while _Wielding_ [_Metal_] Equipment or _Wearing_ [_Metal_] _Armor_.

imbues.name: Harder Hide
imbues.effect: Gain an additional +1 _Block_ if you're wearing [_Metal_] Armor, or +2 if you're wearing at least 4 _Slots_.

name: Novice Galecraft
desc: The fundamentals of galecraft, the primary use of windcraft that simply creates and controls powerful bursts of wind.

abilities.name: Galecraft
Tailwind
abilities.effect: Your _Spirit_ may gain _Stress_ or you may spend 1 [-] to remove a _Danger_ for yourself or an ally that your ability to control and shape wind could mitigate.

abilities.name: Airbending
abilities.effect: You have _Bend_ [_Wind_] within Range 1.

imbues.name: Directed Gusts
imbues.effect: Gain _Bend_ [_All_]. You may only target _Tiny_ objects or create similar effects.

abilities.name: Control Winds
abilities.effect: The _Arena_ gains or removes _Gusting_.

abilities.name: Gust
abilities.effect: Attack a target within Range. This Attack ignores any penalties due to _Gusting_ and instead gains a +1 to the _Attack Roll_ when targeting creatures in a _Gusting_ _Arena_.

enhances.name: Compressed Air
enhances.effect: Deal +_0/1/1/1_ _Stun_ and increase the cost to _Negate_ by 2.

name: Novice Joycraft
desc: After diligent training you have enhanced your joycraft, ensuring that you are always a pleasure to be around.

abilities.name: Joycraft
Joyweaving
abilities.effect: You can subtly weave joycraft into your conversations, slightly influencing others with a general sense of ease and sense of joy while around you. If in an extended conversation with somebody else you may choose yourself or something you talked about; until the end of your next _Downtime_ the target will regard it more favorably. Your _Matchmaker_ should mark this as a _Condition_ so it can be leveraged at a later date. When used in this way your craft is undetectable except by other craft.

abilities.name: Joyful Presence
abilities.effect: When you do not need to be subtle with your craft you can use it to lift the spirits of your allies. Choose an ally; they may roll a die. On a 5+, they clear _Stress_; if they fail the roll, your spirit may gain _Stress_ to instead allow them to succeed.

abilities.name: Inspire Joy
abilities.target: An ally that is not _Anguished_ II or more.
abilities.effect: You may inspire a supernatural sense of joy in an ally. Inflict _Joyful_  on the target; this may not increase them beyond _Joyful_ I.

enhances.name: Joyful Aura
enhances.effect: Instead, resolve the effect on all allies in your _Arena_.

name: Novice Bloomcraft
desc: The fundamentals of bloomcraft, a speciality of woodcraft that focuses on manipulating living plant matter, causing it to bloom, grow, and change.

abilities.name: Bloomcraft
Ripen
abilities.effect: Whenever you find interesting plant life (such as from _Forage_) you may induce growth in nearby plants, forcing some that are near bloom to ripen. Your Spirit gains _Stress_, but you gain +1 _Supply_. You may use this even if there is no plant life; if you do, your spirit instead gains _Fatigue_.

abilities.name: Control Growth
abilities.effect:
Choose one:
* Create an _Overgrown_ _Engagement_.
* Create a _Tripping Hazard_ (_Wood_).
* Remove a piece of _Terrain_ that is a _Minor_ _Source_ (_Wood_).

enhances.name: Wild Growth
enhances.effect: Instead, make the _Arena_ _Overgrown_.

abilities.name: Ensnare
abilities.effect: The Target must _Negate_ [6] or gain _Entangled_ 1. If the Target is in an _Overgrown_ _Arena_, increase the _Negate_ cost by 2 or decrease the Cost by 1. _Fire_ Damage also causes the Target to clear _Entangled_ as if it was _Slash_ Damage.

enhances.name: Massive Growth
enhances.effect: 'Instead, the Target is 'All creatures in an _Overgrown_ _Arena_'.

name: Artist
desc: You are a skilled artist, allowing you to accurately capture imagery of the natural world and create aesthetic constructions.

abilities.name: Artistic Fundamentals
Artistic Analysis
abilities.effect: While you have a _Sketchbook_ you may, as a _Camp Action_, clear a _Stress_ then make an incredibly detailed sketch of something you saw today in your _Sketchbook_. The act of transferring this to your _Sketchbook_ gives you additional information about the target, typically the equivalent of the _Observation_ or _Advantage_ Augment, but may provide additional effects (such as additional _Mastery_ when sketching a significant landmark) at GM discretion.

abilities.name: Artistic Flourish
abilities.effect: When you have the opportunity to add artistic flourishes (including when using your craft) you may spend [ ] as the _Style_ _Augment_.

abilities.name: Artistic Expression
abilities.effect:
During Downtime you may create a grand piece of art of your chosen medium that is too large to easily transport but a wonderful gift to your current location. Choose whether this is an object of Fear, Wonder, or Glory:
* If you choose Fear, you depict a danger you encountered on your adventures.
* If you choose Wonder, you depict something incredible you saw on your journey.
* If you choose Glory, you depict you our your allies accomplishing great things on your journey.

While in the location that has your artwork you have treat it as an Advantage on checks relating to what it depicts or when leaning into its thematic meaning.

name: Merchant
desc: When it comes to bartering and haggling you are the expert; while trade in the Shattered World is complex and unpredictable, you always seem to find the right path forward.

abilities.name: Mercantile
Supply and Demand
abilities.effect: Before starting a _Travel Leg_, your GM must tell you what the next town has an abundance of and what they have a shortage of. When trading these items, you may trade what they have a shortage of as if it was one Rarity higher, and what they have an abundance of one Rarity lower.

abilities.name: Skilled Haggler
abilities.effect: Whenever you encounter traders or enter a new town you may get _Supplies_ for free (2 if a town or larger) through a series of intricate trades.

abilities.name: Secret Stash
abilities.effect: You may rummage through your pack and find something you have tucked away. You may trade _Supplies_ for 2 _Load_ of _Common_ items, or 1 _Load_ of _Uncommon_.
abilities.special: You may regain a use of this ability by foregoing the free _Supplies_ from Skilled Haggler.

abilities.name: Ledgers
abilities.effect: You are able to read and write, and are near-instant with any math you might have to do as a merchant. Gain 1 _Lore_.

name: Delver
desc: The Underworld is a dangerous place, full of archaic machines and deadly traps. Despite this, it's a world of riches, one which you've delved into time and time again.

abilities.name: Delving Expertise
Basic Literacy
abilities.effect: You are able to read and write. Gain 1 _Lore_.

abilities.name: Old World Knowledge
abilities.effect: You can read the Old Script and, while many of the details remain a mystery, you have a better grasp on the history of the Old World than others. You gain increased insights when you encounter ruins and other things from the Old World.

abilities.name: Mechanic
abilities.effect: You have an instinctive understanding of machines and devices from the Old World and, while you can't reproduce them, you can typically determine how to safely operate them and, if damaged, you know what you might need to do to get it in working order. This includes complex machinery, but you are also able to deal with simple devices such as locks given the appropriate tools.

abilities.name: Untrappable
abilities.effect: When you encounter a trap you may roll _Skillfully_ to disarm or avoid it. Additionally, you may assist others with said tasks without spending _Stress_.

abilities.name: Underworld Trail
abilities.effect: When a _Menace_ or _Discovery_ card is drawn from the Travel Deck, you may attempt to glean more info. If it is related to the Underworld, immediately learn additional information, such as the consequences of failure. You may spend [ ] to reveal this card.

name: Herbalist
desc: You are well-studied when it comes to herbs, and can create many basic remedies from them even with limited supplies.

abilities.name: Herbalism
Gather Herbs
abilities.effect: When you _Forage_ as a _Camp_ or _Travel_ _Action_ you always gain +1 _Herbalism Supplies_, and may replace any amount of _Supplies_ you would gain with _Herbalism Supplies_. Additionally, you know the _Uncommon_ and _Rare_ Herbs within the area, and may choose to gain 2 less _Supplies_ to gain a single _Uncommon_ Herb in the area, or 3 less to gain a _Rare_ one.

abilities.name: Field Herbalism
abilities.effect:
As a _Camp Action_ when you have _Herbalism Tools_ you may create something with herbs you have on hand. Choose one:
* _Refine_ an _Herb_ in your possession.
* Expend _Herbalism Supplies_, then gain any two of a _Poultice_ or _Antidote_, in any combination.
* Expend three _Herbalism Supplies_. Gain a _Health Flask_.

abilities.name: Quick Herbalism
abilities.effect: Gain 1 _Stress_; you may immediately use Field Herbalism without using a _Camp Action_.

abilities.name: Cultivation
abilities.effect: You may start a _Journey_ with any amount of _Herbalism Supplies_. Whenever you have downtime in a friendly location you may establish or cultivate a garden. Any Herbs you are carrying can be planted in the location. When you start a _Journey_ from a location with a garden you start with the refined version of herbs in the garden at no Cost, up to one per planted herb. You may instead choose to take the raw herbs themselves.

name: Farmer
desc: You've worked on a farm, making you used to hard physical labor and providing you a wide breadth of knowledge.

abilities.name: Farm Days
Hard Labor
abilities.effect: You may carry 2 more _Load_ in your _Pack_.

abilities.name: High-Quality Produce
abilities.effect: You may trade _Supplies_ for 2 _Good Meals_ as you enjoy food given to you in exchange for farm labor, which typically takes the form of fruit or vegetable preserves, cheeses, or incredibly high quality jerky.
abilities.special: You may refresh one use of this ability by helping at a farm for or similar facility for a day; otherwise, regain all uses whenever you spend _Downtime_ somewhere with a farm or similar facility.

abilities.name: Animal Empathy
abilities.effect:
Your time working with livestock has given you an innate aptitude with animals; they tend to warm to you quickly, and you are better able to read their body language. When you interact with an animal, you may ask the GM one of the following questions and they will answer truthfully:
* What (if anything) is wrong with this animal?
* What is this animal's role in its pack or herd?
* What is this animal currently worried about?
* What can I do to make this animal like me?

 These effects are heightened when interacting with domesticated animals; in such situations, you may always roll _Skillfully_.

name: Physician
desc: You know the basics of medicine, allowing you to better treat the wounds of your allies and keep everybody in top form.

abilities.name: Medical Knowledge
Field Clinic
abilities.effect: Whenever you _Patch_ as a _Camp Action_ you may pay an additional _Supply_ to target an additional creature or instead mark two segments on a _Wound_ clock. If at the end of the _Camp Roll_ an ally you targeted with _Patch_ has removed a _Wound_, clear 1 _Stress_.

abilities.name: Tools of the Trade
abilities.effect: You can use _Physician's Tools_.

abilities.name: Medical Neutrality
abilities.effect: Skilled physicians are rare and prized; when not bearing weapons and demonstrating you are a physician (usually by simply showing your supplies) most other humans will allow you to approach and will typically treat you kindly or, at worst, with skeptical neutrality.

name: Hunter
desc: You are skilled at tracking game, and can easily supply food for your party while hunting.

abilities.name: Hunter
Tracker
abilities.effect: Gain a +1 to the die roll for _Hunt_ and _Track_. You may always look at your current area's _Hunting Chart_, although the GM may hide the specifics of the rarest option on the table. If the result of your _Hunt_ would get you nothing, instead gain 1 _Basic Meal_.

abilities.name: Skilled Hunter
abilities.effect: You may take the _Hunt_ or _Track_ _Travel Action_ without spending any die. You may regain a use of this ability by spending one [ ].

abilities.name: Trail Signs
abilities.effect: When a _Menace_ is drawn from the Travel Deck, you may attempt to glean more info. If your hunter's knowledge would assist, you may treat this _Menace_ as if it was _Scouted_.
abilities.special: You may take 1 _Stress_ to regain a use of this _Ability_.

name: Scholar
desc: You are studious and well-read, a rare trait in the Shattered World.

abilities.name: Scholar
Living Library
abilities.effect: You are able to read and write at a high level. Gain 4 _Lore_.

abilities.name: Walking Library
abilities.effect: You have a small collection of books at home. When you leave for a _Journey_ you may bring up to 3 _Load_ of books relevant to your current travels. Once per _Journey_ per _Load_, you may, as a _Camp Action_, read the books you have packed. Regain 1 _Lore_ and clear a _Stress_. You may not use this if you are at your maximum _Lore_. When at an appropriate location you can typically trade your books for new relevant ones, refreshing the uses of this ability. Leaving the books behind in an unsafe location will cause you to take 2 _Stress_.

name: Keeper
desc: You are one of your town's keepers, one who is in charge of remembering the tales of those that came before and ensuring they do not fade from memory.

abilities.name: Keeper Training
Spiritual Insights
abilities.effect: As a keeper, the tales you learn are partially to honor those that came before and partially to ensure the remnant spirits within your town continue to have a tie to it. Due to this, you are adept at assessing spirits, and can easily determine their approximate power level, even if they are attempting to hide it. If they are a remnant, you can approximate how much longer they have before fully fading away.

abilities.name: Memento Mori
abilities.effect: The remnant spirits within your town treat you in a friendly manner and are inclined to assist you whenever possible. While in your hometown you may gain an _Advantage_ on a _Skill Challenge_ as you call upon a remnant spirit. This power may extend to other towns if you are able to learn a sufficient amount of their history to know the tales of the companions of other remnant spirits.

abilities.name: Calligraphy
abilities.effect: You are able to read and write, and specifically have beautiful, easy-to-read handwriting. Gain 1 _Lore_.

abilities.name: Campfire Tales
abilities.effect: At the start of each _Journey_, gain 6 Story Points. As a _Camp Action_, you can tell a tale from your repertoire, choosing one to help your party relax. Spend any number of of your story points; all your human companions may roll a d6 and add the number of Story Points you spent. If they get a 6 or higher, they may clear a _Stress_.

name: Wanderer
desc: You are an experienced traveler, with a breadth of knowledge of how the roads work and unparalleled traveling endurance.

abilities.name: Roadwise
Adept Traveler
abilities.effect: Roll +1 die when making your _Travel Roll_. You may choose a different _Approach_ from the rest of the party, and may gain _Stress_ to roll _Skillfully_.

name: Ranger
desc: You are an expert in the wilderness, allowing you to easily maneuver across the landscape while finding the time to resupply.

abilities.name: Wilderness Survival
Survival Instinct
abilities.effect: The first time you pull from the _Menace Deck_ you may choose to exclude _Mishaps_ put there due to party members. Additionally, while traveling, you may spend one [ ] to offset the _Menace_ Danger. If you do, roll a d6; on a 3 or higher, gain _Stress_, otherwise gain _Fatigue_.

abilities.name: Multitasking
abilities.effect:
You are an incredibly effective travel and gain the following benefits:
* You may select any number of jobs when you play the _Efficacy_ Advantage.
* You may choose a different _Approach_ than the rest of your party.
* When you play _Indiscretion_, you may remove it from any two characters in the party (including yourself).

abilities.name: Hide All Traces
abilities.effect: You may, without spending a _Camp Action_, add _Hidden_ to your _Camp_. If you do, roll a d6; on a 3-, take a _Stress_.

name: Blacksmith
desc: You are skilled at working with metal and, given a forge and time, can create a variety of tools and arms.

abilities.name: Strength of the Forge
Metallurgy
Metalworking
abilities.effect: When you _Mend_ as a _Camp Action_ and target _Metal_ _Equipment_, clear a _Stress_.

abilities.name: Field Repair
abilities.effect: Gain 1 _Stress_; you may immediately _Mend_ a piece of _Metal_ _Equipment_ without using a _Camp Action_.

abilities.name: Reforge
abilities.effect: As a _Camp Action_, you may choose a _Destroyed_ piece of _Metal_ _Equipment_. Spend 1 _Supplies_, then restore it to 1 _Durability_. This Action requires appropriate tools.

abilities.name: Forge-Trained
abilities.effect: Given appropriate tools and materials, you may craft Metal equipment. Most basic or rough tools can be crafted in a few hours, with more intricate or complicated tools taking longer.[Item crafting with extra benefits for metal]

name: Weaponsmith
desc: You specialize in crafting weapons of war, and few are your equal when crafting them.

abilities.name: Weapon Academia
Hone
abilities.effect: As a _Camp Action_, choose an ally (including yourself) without a _Weaponsmith's Blessing_. You may take the time to maintain that ally's weaponry, granting them a _Weaponsmith's Blessing_.

abilities.name: Weapon Maintenance
abilities.effect: Gain 1 _Stress_; you may _Mend_ or Hone without using a _Camp Action_. You may only target Weapons_.

abilities.name: Field Maintenance
abilities.effect: Whenever you _Mend_ a _Weapon_, roll a d6; on a 5+, you do not need to spend _Supplies_.

abilities.name: Forge Weapon
abilities.effect:
Given appropriate tools and materials, you may craft Weapons. All but the most crude of weapons take some time to craft. [Item crafting with extra benefits for weapons]

Additionally, at the start of a _Journey_, grant yourself and all allies a _Weaponsmith's Blessing_.

name: Tough
desc: You are exceptionally tough, pushing through any difficulty with determination and grit.

abilities.name: Exceptional Toughness
Boon of Toughness
abilities.effect: When your exceptional resilieince is relevant you may spend one [ ] as [-] or the _Duration_ _Augment_, if appropriate.

abilities.name: Toughened Hide
abilities.effect: You are naturally resilient and can power through rain, sleet, and heat. You may spend one [ ] to remove a _Danger_ related to extreme weather or other harsh conditions.

abilities.name: Grin and Bear It
abilities.effect: Gain an additional segment on your _Health Bar_.

abilities.name: Toughness
abilities.effect: Gain +2 Stamina and Guard.

abilities.name: True Grit
abilities.effect: The triggering effect cannot reduce you below 1 _Stamina_. You automatically _Negate_ at no Cost.

name: Clever
desc: You have a keen mind, and can often think your way out of a problem that would ensnare other.

abilities.name: Exceptional Mind
Boon of Cleverness
abilities.effect: When using your keen mind you may spend one [ ] as if it were [-] or for the _Advantage_ Augment, if appropriate.

abilities.name: All According to Plan
abilities.effect: You are constantly creating plans and contingencies, which sometimes come into play. Whenever you have a bonus die related to preparation, you may roll _Skillfully_.

abilities.name: Always Prepared
abilities.effect: When faced with a _Skill Challenge_ you may declare that you'd planned for this contingency. Take a _Stress_, then describe your preparations. Gain an additional die as if you had prepared.

abilities.name: Exceptional Plot
abilities.effect:
At _Respite_, inflict _Studied_ on a creature within Range 2, then choose one of the following plans:
* **Focus Fire!**: Choose a creature. Every time you or an ally would remove _Studied_ from the target creature, roll a d6. On a 3+, do not remove _Studied_.
* **Form Up!**: This _Round_ whenever an ally becomes _Engaged_ with another ally, both gain 2 _Guard_, up to once per _Turn_ per pair of allies.
* **Scatter!**: At the start of _Phase_ 1 you and all allies may spend up to 2 _Speed_ as if it was your _Turn_.

abilities.name: Exploit Opening
abilities.effect: Remove _Studied_ from the Target. They must immediately _Negate_ [6]. Regardless of the result, they create an _Opening_. If they successfully _Negate_, they gain 4 _Block_ against all resulting Attacks.

name: Observant
desc: You are adept at reading people, and can pick up on small changes in a character's demeanor.

abilities.name: Exceptional Observation
Boon of Observation
abilities.effect: When using your powers of observation you may spend one [ ] as [-] or the _Observation_ Augment, if appropriate.

abilities.name: Social Observation
abilities.effect:
When interacting with people, you may tap into your observational powers to gain additional insight. Ask one of the following questions, which the GM must answer honestly:
* What is the general emotional state of the room?
* Is this person lying or attempting to deceive us?
* What does this person want right now?
abilities.special: You may take 1 _Stress_ to regain a use of this _Ability_.

abilities.name: Unlicensed Therapist
abilities.effect: When a _Menace_ Card is revealed, you may attempt to glean more info. If the card is related to conflict or inter-party turmoil immediately learn additional information, such as the consequences of failure. You may spend one [ ] to remove this _Menace_ or, if it is a _Minor Mishap_, may take a _Stress_ to remove it. If you learn no information about the card, do not spend a use.
abilities.special: You may roll a d6 to regain a use of this _Ability_; on a 3-, take 1 _Stress_.

abilities.name: Sense Intent
abilities.effect: At _Respite_ choose any enemy. The GM must tell you what category their selected _Stance_ is. If it is not an _Offensive_ _Stance_, inflict _Studied_. If it is an _Offensive_ _Stance_, instead learn how the enemy will select its Target.

abilities.name: Uncanny Observation
abilities.effect: The Target becomes _Studied_. If a character uses a _Social_ effect against them, they may remove _Studied_ to cause them to automatically fail the _Negate_ roll instead of the usual _Studied_ effect.

name: Charming
desc: You have an easy smile and an innate charm, making others feel at ease in your presence.

abilities.name: Exceptional Charm
Boon of Charm
abilities.effect: When using your natural charm you may spend one [ ] as [-] or the _Incitement_ Augment, if appropriate.

abilities.name: First Impression
abilities.effect: When meeting a new character you may charm them, causing them to treat you in a more friendly fashion. For example, a stranger might treat you as a friend, or a hostile creature may act more neutrally. If you attempt a _Skill Challenge_ against this character in the same _Scene_, you may roll _Skillfully_.
abilities.special: You may take 1 _Stress_ to regain a use of this _Ability_.

abilities.name: Fast Friends
abilities.effect: You start each _Journey_ with a _Bond_ with each of your allies.

abilities.name: Charming Presence
abilities.effect: At _Respite_ either target two allies with _Encourage_ [_Discount_ 1] or a single ally [_Discount_ 2].

abilities.name: Charm Offensive
abilities.effect: Deal 1 _Stun_ to the Target, then they must Negate [5]. On a failure, they have _Disadvantage_ to attack you until you make a hostile action against them, or they become afflicted with a similar effect.

name: Tricky
desc: You are an adept lier and can convince almost anybody about anything.

abilities.name: Exceptional Guile
Boon of Guile
abilities.effect: When using your guile to deceive or steer or a conversation you may spend one [ ] as [-] or the _Subtlety_ Augment, if appropriate.

abilities.name: White Lie
abilities.effect: When you lie, you may use this power to ensure the other person believes it, if only for a few moments. If the lie is believable, the listener believes it until proven wrong. If it is questionable, they believe it for the rest of the day. If it is unbelievable, they believe it for the rest of the conversation. If it is obviously false, they believe it for a few moments.

abilities.name: Silver-Tongued Recovery
abilities.effect: Even with all your skill, you sometimes say the wrong thing. You may use this Power to immediately walk back something you said, causing the conversation to go back uninterrupted, effectively causing the person you are talking with to forget you ever mentioned that.

abilities.name: Shifty
abilities.effect: Whenever your GM asks a question to determine how an NPC behaves, you may lie about your current status such as your current _Guard_, _Stamina_, number of _Wounds_, _Statuses_ you are affected by or other personal attributes. You may only lie about stats on your character sheet, and may not lie about information obvious on the battle map, such as whether you are the closest character to an enemy. You may only lie when its relevant for NPC targeting; abilities that deal additional effects based on your current _Stamina_ or similar still trigger as normal, and Status effects affect you as normal.

abilities.name: Unflappable
abilities.effect: It costs half as much to _Negate_ the first _Emotional Status_ you're inflicted with each _Round_.

abilities.name: Beguile
abilities.effect: Deal 1 _Stun_ to the Target, then inflict your choice of _Impaired_ [4] or _Exposed_ [4].

enhances.name: Improved Beguilement
enhances.effect: Instead, deal 3 _Stun_ to the Target, then inflict _Taunted_ [6]. You may choose any ally to be treated as the taunter.

name: Strong
desc: You possess incredible physical strength, allowing you to accomplish feats that others could not even dream of.

abilities.name: Exceptional Strength
Boon of Strength
abilities.effect: When using your tremendous strength you may spend one [ ] as [-] or the _Efficacy_ Augment, if appropriate.

abilities.name: Overwhelming Power
abilities.effect: When rolling _Boldly_ and using your strength you may use this Ability to roll an additional 2 die, but automatically add the _Mayhem_ _Danger_.
abilities.special: You may take 1 _Stress_ to regain a use of this Ability.

abilities.name: Strong Back
abilities.effect: You may carry 2 _Load_ without it affecting your _Encumbrance_.

abilities.name: Mighty
abilities.effect: You may, when it would be beneficial, treat yourself as Size 3 instead of Size 2. Decrease the Cost to _Negate_ _Grabbed_ and _Forced Movement_ by 1.

abilities.name: Strong Strike
abilities.effect:
Whenever you make a _Martial Attack_, choose one:
* Deal +1 _Stun_.
* Convert 1 Damage to _Stun_.

Repeat this effect X times, where X is the base Cost of the original Attack.

name: Swift
desc: You are fleet of foot and incredibly nimble, allowing you to outrun your peers with ease.

abilities.name: Fleet of Foot
Boon of Swiftness
abilities.effect: When your exceptional speed is relevant you may spend one [ ] as [-] or the _Speed_ _Augment_, if appropriate.

abilities.name: Quick March
abilities.effect: During _Travel_, you may spend one [ ] as [+] for a _Speed_ _Augment_. You may gain _Fatigue_ to instead allow an ally to spend one of their [ ] as [+] as you help them compensate for their pace.

abilities.name: Incredible Speed
abilities.effect: Gain +1 _Speed_.

abilities.name: Agility
abilities.effect: Take a _Turn_ this _Phase_. You may only use _Mobility_ abilities and _Move_.
abilities.special: Increase the _Cost_ of this by 1 _Momentum_ each time you use it in a _Round_.
